messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] metering-service token-emit-rate deviation detected in eu-west-1 (P2). spike -> low emit for multiple partitions. alert: https://pager.redwood.internal/alerts/MT-4321 :rotating_light:
oncall-lee: on it. checking kinesis consumer offsets + emitter logs.
oncall-lee: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-20T21:04:02Z metering-producer-3 emit_rate=0.04/s consumer_lag=12872 partition=az-3
2026-03-20T21:04:12Z backpressure=true 
```
sre-amy: seeing delayed usage batches in the ingestion table for ~14m (max lag per partition ~13k msgs). query: `SELECT partition, max(lag) FROM metering_lag WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'`
billing-ops: noticed automated overage flags firing for a handful of EU trial orgs around 21:05 UTC. I'm seeing emails and alert flags in the billing queue.
support-dan: two customers (acct: AcmeCorp, acct: FinchMedia) reported overage emails ~21:06 and opened tickets. tagging account teams.
oncall-lee: trying a rolling restart of metering-producer-3 to unstick emitter. will bump offsets if restart doesn't free it.
ops-bot: Restarting pod metering-producer-3 in namespace=prod-eu-west1 (node eu-west-1b) -- command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/metering-producer`
ops-bot: Pod metering-producer-3 restarted (age 12.4s). healthcheck passed.
oncall-lee: quick check: emit_rate improved to 2.1/s for partitions az-1/az-2, az-3 still low. running offset bump on az-3: `kinesis-cli set-shard-iterator --shard-id shardId-003 --type TRIM_HORIZON`
sre-amy: started backfill job to replay delayed messages into the billing aggregator. ETA ~1-2h to reconcile counts. will monitor for duplicate suppression.
billing-ops: muting overage notification pipeline for EU trial flag channel to avoid noisy customer emails while we triage. will keep billing records immutable; only suppress customer notices. :no_bell:
support-dan: created CS ticket TCK-982, sent templated note to AcmeCorp + FinchMedia explaining transient billing alert and reconciliation window. linking incident thread.
sre-amy: preliminary root cause: consumer loop entering a compaction-induced stall when small head-of-line message causes extreme backpressure on shard iterator; PR opened to add a circuit-breaker + short-circuit on stalled commits (PR: https://github.com/redwood/metering/pull/881).
oncall-lee: summary for handoff -> @sre-miguel in 10m: actions taken: restarted producer pod, bumped az-3 offsets, started backfill; current status: ~92% of tokens emitted, ETAs: backfill finishes in ~1–2h, billing flags muted for customer notifications, CS notified. customer impact: transient overage emails for a very small set (trial orgs) — no final billing deltas expected after reconciliation.
sre-miguel: ack, grabbing handoff. please paste the exact offset bump command and any logs I should watch. I'll take postmortem + follow-up next shift.
oncall-lee: offset bump command: `kinesis-cli set-shard-iterator --stream metering-v2 --shard-id shardId-003 --type AT_SEQUENCE_NUMBER --starting-sequence-number 4958273`
sre-miguel: thanks — I'll monitor emit_rate, consumer_lag, and billing-emit-success metrics (dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/meters/emit). switching to incident status: monitoring. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
